sources.note: Azure Machine Learning bills the underlying compute with no service surcharge; managed online endpoints and compute clusters run on the VM rates below.

serverless.note: ACI bills the container group for its lifetime, per second, whether or not a request is in flight. The placement that answers to the name serverless on this provider is not per-request billed, which is itself a finding the comparison table surfaces rather than papers over.
